_doc: Commissions (design/people/people-and-side-activities-spec.md §6; build item N-7.6.3): small paid jobs, texture and never story (no clue, key, spell or road; no named fate). Each: title, giver (a role, said in words), board (the camp place it is posted at), from/to (the days of the year it is posted; once taken it stays open until done), steps (in order; each the line the HUD's jobs line and the Ledger show, and the map and place it is done at), pay (crowns), hook (the matter hook: `spare` {place, kinds} is met when no prop of those kinds in that place is burning, burned or broken as the job's step there ends, without `spare` it is met when its scene says so (the story's `commission <id> clean`); either way it pays `bonus` more, 0.5 = +50%), text (the hook as the board says it). A step done in a past life shows its answer and takes no time (Run.soul commissions {id: life done}). Nothing is posted in the week before a calamity. A fight lost leaves the step open and the slow way (half pay). Scenes: data/world/story/commissions.story (the board) and each map's story.

steps.text: Find the herder's goat in the webbed orchard
Bring the goat back to the board

hook.text: Light the dark ditch, not the hay.

steps.text: Clear the bramble field on the Mill road
Tell the carter at the board

hook.text: Burn the bramble, not the fence.

steps.text: Walk the night round to the waystation on the east road
Fetch the scavenger's chest from Cinder Row
Bring the chest to the board

hook.text: Shore up the beam before you pull the chest.

c5_flood.title: The Cellar Flood
c5_flood.giver: A widow of the fallen city

steps.text: Stop the water in the undercroft's grate hall
Tell the widow at the board

hook.text: Freeze it or drain it. Don't crack the wall.

steps.text: Run the bully off the quarry on the east road
Tell the quarryman at the board

hook.text: Don't bring the quarry down on the workers.

steps.text: Clear the rats from the granary loft
Tell the miller at the board
Carry a letter to the Knights' picket on the east road
Carry a letter to Bell Street in the fallen city
Tell the scribe at the board
